name: Innovex Pressure Washer IPW003
description: 1600W Innovex high-pressure washer with 130 bar max pressure and 5m hose. Ideal for car, garden and outdoor cleaning.
details: The Innovex IPW003 Pressure Washer is a powerful 1600W domestic unit designed for effective outdoor cleaning. It delivers up to 130 bar pressure and comes with a 5-metre high-pressure hose, adjustable spray nozzle, short spray gun, foam dispenser, connection lance, inlet filter and quick hose connector. Suitable for cleaning vehicles, pathways, gardens and outdoor areas in Sri Lankan homes.
